2608.05205.title: Abstract Event Causal Rules: Induction and Application
2608.05205.paper_summary: Event-centric intelligent analytical systems heavily depend on explicit causal event knowledge for risk early warning, decision-making support and narrative comprehension. Nevertheless, existing instance-level causal pairs suffer severe generalization deficits on low-frequency long-tail and unseen event combinations. To address this limitation, this work proposes Abstract Event Causal Rule (AECR), a novel relation-level causal abstraction paradigm that transforms concrete cause-effect pairs into generalized abstract causal logic while retaining their intrinsic causal relationships. We design a multi-agent Concrete-to-Abstract Causal Induction (CACI) system coupled with similarity-constrained clustering to distill trustworthy AECRs from noisy raw causal data, based on which two complete AECR knowledge bases are built. To validate the practical utility of abstract causal knowledge, we propose an Abstract Rule-Guided Causal Attention Encoder (AR-GCAE), which injects the retrieved AECRs into the causality Graph Event Prediction (CGEP) benchmark task via rule-guided attention layers and gated representation fusion. Quantitative experimental results reveal that applying AECRs substantially strengthens the generalization capacity of event causal reasoning and brings consistent performance improvements to event prediction, with the most prominent gains observed on rare and unseen event samples.
2608.05205.paper_summary_zh: 事件中心的智能分析系統在風險預警、決策支持和敘事理解方面嚴重依賴明確的因果事件知識。<lb/>然而，現有的實例級因果對在低頻長尾和未見事件組合上存在嚴重的泛化缺陷。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，本研究提出了抽象事件因果規則（AECR），這是一種新穎的關係級因果抽象範式，將具體的因果對轉化為一般化的抽象因果邏輯，同時保留其內在的因果關係。<lb/>我們設計了一個多代理的具體到抽象因果誘導（CACI）系統，結合相似性約束聚類，從雜訊原始因果數據中提煉可信的AECR，並基於此構建了兩個完整的AECR知識庫。<lb/>為了驗證抽象因果知識的實用性，我們提出了一個抽象規則引導的因果注意力編碼器（AR-GCAE），通過規則引導的注意力層和閘控表示融合，將檢索到的AECR注入因果圖事件預測（CGEP）基準任務中。<lb/>定量實驗結果顯示，應用AECR顯著增強了事件因果推理的泛化能力，並為事件預測帶來了一致的性能提升，在稀有和未見事件樣本上觀察到最顯著的增益。
